# ResumeProof Match

ResumeProof Match is an end-to-end, evidence-first Skill for AI agents.

Primary entrypoint: SKILL.md
Matching contract: references/matching.md
Approval and delivery contract: references/delivery.md
Deterministic CLI: scripts/resume_proof_match.py

Core invariants:
- Every fit conclusion maps a JD requirement to traceable evidence.
- Role fit, evidence coverage, and document readiness remain separate.
- Scores are not ATS pass probabilities.
- Unsupported claims never enter a resume draft.
- Complete text approval is required before formatted files.
- QA is bound to approved text and output file hashes.
- External application, upload, publication, messaging, and Desktop delivery require explicit authorization.
